9931666/dsh-plugin-roundtable.description: (roundtable V1.0.0) Upgrades a DeepSeek Harness session from 'you and the AI chatting one-on-one' into 'you + a moderator (DeepSeek) + a ring of expert AIs holding a roundtable meeting'
9931666/dsh-plugin-roundtable.body:
## In one sentence

> You only raise the topic. DeepSeek acts as moderator, brings up a ring of expert nodes on the topology diagram, organizes collaboration with arrowed connection lines, consolidates results through a convergence gateway, and hands the decision back to you when there is disagreement.

## Features

### Meeting organization
| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Left moderator + right roundtable topology** | The session view adds a 'Roundtable' tab: moderator anchor on the left, ring of expert nodes on the right, convergence gateway in the center. Connection lines carry directional arrows, so the whole meeting is visualized throughout. |
| **Persistent sub-agent experts** | Each expert is an independent sub-agent that can be resumed. It joins the meeting carrying the *Global Collaboration Charter* (goals / role boundaries / collaboration protocol / safety red lines), and can be assigned models from different vendors. |
| **Visual connections** | Hover over a node and drag the '+' to draw a connection. Right-click a connection to switch between one-way and two-way channels, or delete it. Two-way channels have an arrow at each end. |
| **Vendor logo avatars** | Expert avatars show real vendor logos (DeepSeek / GLM / z.ai / Gemini / Claude / Kimi / MiniMax / Qwen). Vendors not yet included automatically fall back to a 'brand-color block + abbreviation'. To replace logo images, swap files in `src/client/assets/logos/`, then re-run `node scripts/generate-logos.mjs` and rebuild. |
| **Status breathing light** | While an expert is working, the node edge pulses with a breathing light. This is pure CSS status feedback and consumes no tokens. |
| **Canvas legend (mode semantics)** | The top-left corner of the canvas states how to read the diagram in the current mode: moderated (hub dispatches one turn at a time), multi-model equal (experts debate directly), adversarial (only point out flaws). Skeleton channels added by the system are labeled 'dashed line = skeleton channel, not a real flow'. The same diagram means different things in the three modes, and writing the legend on the diagram is deliberate. Without it, users would read the diagram as a control-flow path chart. **The legend has a close (×) button in its top-right corner.** The closed state is saved to global preferences and stays closed after refresh. It can be reopened at any time from 'Canvas legend' on the settings page. Closing must be reversible, otherwise 'delete' becomes a one-way operation. |
| **Node status shown honestly** | Nodes directly show the real status of persistent sub-agents: **Working / Idle / Ready / Not woken / Host lost / Exited** (hover for the full explanation). The design deliberately **does not invent** 'Completed / Failed'. A sub-agent that finishes a round returns to idle and can be woken again, so saying it has 'ended' would be wrong. Status labels are kept short on purpose: nodes are only 68px wide, and long labels wrap and overflow the circular card (`就绪（可唤醒）` already caused this). Semantic detail therefore goes into the hover tooltip, and the label itself is forced onto a single line with ellipsis truncation. |

### Collaboration and debate

Amer-CN/proxydeck.body:
#### Turn your AI subscriptions into a local OpenAI-compatible API that any client can use

---

Do you have subscriptions to CommandCode, Codely (团结), or WorkBuddy (Tencent CodeBuddy) but can only use them inside their own clients? **ProxyDeck converts these subscriptions into a single local OpenAI-compatible API** (`http://127.0.0.1:55990/v1`). Codex, Cursor, and any agent that supports a custom Base URL can connect directly. One exe, double-click to use, zero installation and zero configuration.

The interface is a **mechanical control panel**: a cream-colored body, traffic lights at the top, a black dot-matrix screen, and an ignition lever. Starting the proxy isn't a button press. You pull the lever from left to right, accompanied by a self-check light ceremony and a real ratchet sound effect.

## 🚀 Quick Start

1. **Download**: Download `ProxyDeck.exe` from [Releases](https://github.com/Amer-CN/proxydeck/releases) (single file, about 24MB, no installation needed)
2. **Ignite**: Double-click to open, and pull the red lever on the COMMAND deck all the way to the right
3. **Connect**: Enter the following in your AI client:

```
Base URL:  http://127.0.0.1:55990/v1
API Key:   your CommandCode Key (commandcode.ai/studio → API keys)
```

Supported platforms (each has its own deck and lever):

| Platform | Port | Login method |
|---|---|---|
| CommandCode | 55990 | API Key |
| Codely (团结) | 8788 | Automatically reads the login state from ~/.codely-cli |
| WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy) | 8787 | Automatically reads the login state from the desktop app |
| Comate (Baidu) | 8786 | Automatically reads the Comate login state (IDE takes priority) |
| Qoder (Alibaba) | 8785 | Automatically reads the login state from the desktop app |
| B.AI | 8891 | Enter the key on the water-injection detection page |
| VIBEX | 8790 | Auto-detect or manually paste a token |
| Madao (Huawei Cloud) | 8793 | Automatically reads the login state from the desktop app |

> **Each platform requires your own valid subscription.** This tool only performs API conversion and does not include any account resources.

## 👀 Interface Overview

Four mode keys switch between decks. The black dot-matrix screen at the top shows the running status in real time. Scrolling the page produces real mouse-wheel ratchet sounds. Hover over any model for 1 second and the screen shows its price and context parameters.

## ✨ Core Features

- **🔥 Ignition lever**: Mechanical ceremonial start/stop interaction. Pulling it back to the far left while running shuts it down.
- **📊 Usage statistics**: Authoritative figures from the official website (amount/tokens/quota) plus local statistics, visible even offline.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

SpaceRelay/dsh-subagent-control.body:
# dsh-subagent-control

**Lets any agent — including team members — list, follow up on, and interrupt the subagents it has spawned.**

`list_subagents` · `send_subagent_message` · `interrupt_subagent`

> [English](https://github.com/SpaceRelay/dsh-subagent-control/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Chinese

## When to use it

- You spawned several subagents to work in parallel and want to know which are still running and how far they've gotten
- You want to add a note to a subagent that's currently running
- You want to stop one that's going off track and reclaim its turn
- In a team, sub-subagents spawned by the team lead should also stay under control from the top down

## The three tools

| Tool | What it does | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list_subagents` | Lists the subagents you spawned | `scope`: `children` (default, direct subagents) / `descendants` (entire subtree); `include_teammates`: defaults to `true` |
| `send_subagent_message` | Sends a message to a direct subagent | `subagent_id`, `message` |
| `interrupt_subagent` | Stops a subagent's current turn | `subagent_id` |

It looks like this:

```
list_subagents
→ 3b0f9c1e  running  "review the patch"  depth=1

list_subagents scope=descendants
→ 3b0f9c1e  running  "review the patch"  depth=1
  7d2a44b0  inactive "check the tests"    depth=2

send_subagent_message subagent_id=3b0f9c1e message="While you're at it, take a look at locale/zh.json"
→ messageId=...

interrupt_subagent subagent_id=3b0f9c1e
→ accepted=true
```

Each line is `id  status  "label"  depth=`. `running` means the subagent is currently executing a turn. `inactive` only means no turn is running right now — **it does not mean the subagent is gone**; sending it a message will wake it up.

Teammates on the team are themselves resumable subagents, so they also appear in the list, marked `team=teammate`. If you only want the regular subagents you spawned, pass `include_teammates: false`.

# Desktop Icon Billiards · Desktop Icon Billiards

**Set up Windows desktop icons as a game of billiards.** Aim by moving the mouse on the desktop, hold the left button to charge power, and release to strike. Icons keep their own thumbnails, roll, collide, and drop into pockets. When you quit, the desktop is restored as it was.

Windows 10 / 11 x64 · Single-file EXE · MIT

## Download

The Windows version v0.2.3 is a single-file EXE. [GitHub download](https://github.com/liuxiaogang-com/desktop-icon-billiards/releases/download/v0.2.3/DesktopIconBilliards-0.2.3-win-x64.exe) · [CNB mirror download](https://cnb.cool/liuxiaogang/desktop-icon-billiards/-/releases/download/v0.2.3/DesktopIconBilliards-0.2.3-win-x64.exe)

The source code and release assets for `desktop-icon-billiards` are synced across both platforms. [GitHub repository](https://github.com/liuxiaogang-com/desktop-icon-billiards) · [CNB mirror repository](https://cnb.cool/liuxiaogang/desktop-icon-billiards)

The official site entry is [Desktop Icon Billiards](https://go.liuxiaogang.com/zmtq).

## How to Play

1. After launching, wait for the desktop icons to settle. Move the mouse to choose the cue ball's direction, **hold the left button to charge, and release to shoot**. A "Power" progress bar appears near where you pressed. Power cycles between 0% and 100%: it rises to full in 1.5 seconds and falls back to zero in 1.5 seconds. The progress bar shows the percentage and the direction of change. Release to shoot at the current power; a light tap gives a small nudge.
2. Use "**Aim Assist · On / Off**" to toggle aiming guides. The white line marks the path before the first collision. The blue line shows the direction of the cue ball after it hits a ball or rail. The green line shows the direction of the struck icon. You can see the direction while a shot is pending. The path does not change with the charge level, and it is drawn up to the next collision or pocket. Aim assist lines do not represent actual roll distance; whether a shot reaches its target still depends on shot power. The guide lines have an outline and switch automatically between dark and light colors based on wallpaper brightness, so they stay visible on light wallpapers. Faint collision circles are also drawn along the path: the position of the cue ball at the instant of contact, and the collision range of the struck icon. The latter is slightly larger than the icon itself, and it is the circle used for actual collision detection. When an icon is hit, a ring also flashes around it.
3. The main window shows the elapsed time, the number of pocketed icons, and the number of remaining icons. When the cue ball falls into a pocket, it is automatically reset if a suitable position is available. If there is no suitable position, click an empty area of the table to place it. Pocketing the cue ball does not count toward the pocket total.
4. After clearing the table, view the total time and total icon count. Click "**Restart**" to reset the game, or restart partway through.
5. Click "Quit", press `Esc`, or use the global shortcut…

> An open-source tool for editing, reading, typesetting, auditioning, and exporting jianpu and staff notation. Write scores, recognize scores, typeset, listen, and export. margbug01/ShoesGUI.body:
# MyShoes

A native Windows and macOS GUI for the shoes proxy core, with subscriptions, latency testing and rule-based routing.

[Website](https://margbug01.github.io/ShoesGUI/) · [English](https://margbug01.github.io/ShoesGUI/en.html) · [Download](https://github.com/margbug01/ShoesGUI/releases/latest)

A pleasant Windows / macOS proxy client

A native GUI for the [shoes](https://github.com/cfal/shoes) core: one-click subscription updates, v2rayN-style speed testing, rule-based routing, and tray residency.

     

## Why use it

**Ready to use on launch.** The core runs resident with MyShoes. The "Connect" button on the dashboard only takes over the system proxy. You can test latency without connecting, and enter `127.0.0.1:10808` directly into other programs.

**Subscriptions stay live.** Subscription URLs are bound to groups. When you click "Update subscription", nodes with the same name are replaced in place with the new config, new nodes are added, and removed nodes are deleted. Nodes you manually added to that group are left untouched. When reading subscriptions, it sends v2rayN's User-Agent, because airports return share links rather than a full Clash YAML.

**Speed testing as accurate as v2rayN.** "Real connection latency" starts a separate core used only for testing, sends two `generate_204` requests through each node, and keeps the smaller result. TCPing is also available. You can sort by latency and use "Use fastest" with one click. Results follow the node configuration: changing the config or updating the subscription resets them for retesting.

**Status that doesn't mislead.** The speed curve (hover to see upload and download for that second), current traffic, active connections, core memory, and real exit IP are all on the dashboard. The bottom of the sidebar always shows whether you're connected and which node is in use. When the system proxy isn't taken over, the exit card tells you directly that the browser is currently connecting directly.

**Quietly in the tray.** Closing the window just minimizes it to the tray (on macOS, the top menu bar). Right-click to connect or disconnect, switch nodes, or switch modes. A gray icon means the proxy isn't taken over; green means it is.

**See how each site is routed.** The "Connection log" on the Logs page is similar to v2rayN's connections page. It lists each domain: whether it went direct or through which node, which rule matched (China domains, China IPs, LAN, the rest), how many connections were made, and how much traffic. You can show only proxied or only direct traffic, search, and right-click to copy a domain or close its connections. Records are kept in memory only and are cleared when you quit MyShoes.

**Logs in plain language.** Common single-connection errors are translated into Chinese, and counts are merged within one minute. Only important entries are shown by default, errors are highlighted in red, and you can search, select and copy, or copy everything with one click to share.

**Data stays local.**…

piaobo2233/deadlock-translator.body:
## Key features

- **Receive translation**. Local OCR reads English, Russian, Japanese, and Korean chat, and shows Simplified Chinese below each bubble. The panel lets you view and copy the original text and the translation.
- **Send translation**. After you confirm the target language and turn it on, copy Chinese text in the game. The assistant writes a translation that passes language validation to the clipboard, and you paste and send it.
- **Local first**. It checks the glossary, translation memory, and cache first. If there is no match, it can call the translation service you configure. The provider may charge fees.
- **Personal glossary**. New installs start from zero. Qualifying Chinese translations returned by the API are added automatically. Official terms and common abbreviations are separate built-in references and do not count toward the personal glossary.

## Installation, updates, and uninstallation

- **First install**. Download `LockLingo-<version>-setup.exe` and install it to a writable directory with an all-English path, such as `D:\LockLingo`. In first-time setup, draw a box around the game chat area, or use the reference range first. You can skip the API Key and use the local glossary, translation memory, and cache. To translate new sentences, configure an API endpoint and turn on "Online translation".
- **Updates**. The installed version checks for updates under "Settings → Software update". You can also overwrite the original directory with a new installer. Personal data stays in the original directory.
- **Uninstall**. The installed version opens the uninstaller under "Settings → Uninstall → Uninstall LockLingo". If you keep your data, you can reinstall in the original directory and continue using it. A complete uninstall permanently deletes personal data in the install directory, along with the backups and recognition records that LockLingo created.

See [Installation and first use](https://github.com/piaobo2233/deadlock-translator/blob/HEAD/docs/guides/安装与首次使用.md).

## Scope of use

It is mainly designed for fullscreen or borderless windowed mode on the primary display. Recognition results vary across resolutions, display scaling, and match scenarios. When online translation is on, the text to be translated is sent with each request to the selected provider. The API Key is used for endpoint authentication and is stored in plain text in `data/config.json` in the program directory. For automated checks, live matches, display environments, and the official installer, see the test status below.

tallcat4/std-t98-receiver-sharp.body:
# STD-T98 Receiver for SDR#

A plugin that demodulates ARIB STD-T98 in SDR#. It decodes AMBE+2 voice and automatically decodes scrambling codes, including enhanced scrambling (強化秘話) for Alinco digital simple radios.
Based on [std-t98-receiver](https://github.com/tallcat4/std-t98-receiver), [std-t98-cracker](https://github.com/tallcat4/std-t98-cracker), [std-t98-vocode](https://github.com/tallcat4/std-t98-vocode), and [SPEAR](https://github.com/tallcat4/SPEAR).

## Two add-ons

| | STD-T98 Receiver | STD-T98 97ch Monitor |
|---|---|---|
| Distribution file | `STD-T98-Receiver.zip` | `STD-T98-Monitor.zip` |
| Reception | 1 channel tuned in SDR# | All 97 channels of registered stations at once |
| History | None (recording is optional) | All channels saved automatically, playback via communication status diagram |

Install only what you need. If you install both, only one can receive at a time.

## Installation

Extract the zip and copy the folder inside `Plugins` to SDR#'s `Plugins` folder. When updating, overwrite the files but keep `secret-cache.json` (for Monitor, also keep `reception-v2.sqlite3` and the date-based history logs).

## STD-T98 Receiver

Pressing the Start Reception button (受信開始) begins demodulation, descrambling, and audio playback of the currently tuned channel. When recording is enabled, `.wav`, `.burst`, `.llr`, and `.jsonl` files are saved (format: [FORMAT.md](https://github.com/tallcat4/std-t98-receiver-sharp/blob/HEAD/FORMAT.md)).

## STD-T98 97ch Monitor

Set the SDR# input to 0.8 to 3.2 Msps and press Start Reception (受信開始) to demodulate all 97 channels simultaneously. While receiving, SDR#'s LO is adjusted automatically.

- The information and eye pattern for the channel selected in the channel list are shown on the right, and its audio plays (use 全chミックス for all channels mixed).
- All reception is saved to `reception-v2.sqlite3` in the plugin folder. It uses about 3.6 GB per hour.

# Battle Cats Web Editor

**A web-based save editing and backup tool for The Battle Cats. No installation or jailbreak required.**

---

## Project Overview

Battle Cats Web Editor is a web-based save editing tool designed for The Battle Cats players. There is no need to install complicated modifiers on your phone, and no need to jailbreak your phone or obtain root access. Just open a browser, enter the in-game transfer code (引繼碼), and you can directly adjust resources, unlock cats, and change your progress. After you finish editing, the tool automatically generates a new transfer code, which you can use to transfer the save back to your phone so you can keep playing.

## Problems Solved

- No jailbreak, no root: Say goodbye to the tedious process of installing unknown modified APKs or changing system files. Everything is done through a pure web interface.
- Built-in safety protection against bans: Built-in value safety limits. Cat Food, XP, and tickets all have reasonable upper limits. Only the items you actually change are uploaded, which reduces the risk of detection by official server anomaly checks.
- Account copying and alt accounts: A one-click account copy function copies your full save progress to a brand-new account, which is useful for trying different team lineups or creating alt accounts.
- History backups prevent mistakes: The backend automatically records the history of each change. If you make a mistake or want to start over, you can restore with one click at any time, so you don't have to worry about save corruption.

## Core Features

### 1. Resource and Gacha Ticket Editing
- Core supplies: Freely edit Cat Food, XP, NP (Instinct Points), and Leadership Boss Flags.
- Gacha tickets and shards: Supports Silver Tickets, Gold Tickets, Platinum Tickets, Legend Tickets, Platinum Shards, and event Lucky Tickets.
- Growth materials and items: Full item adjustment, including battle items, Catamins, Cat Eyes, Catnip, Castle building materials, Instinct Jewels, Labyrinth Medals, and more.

### 2. Full Cat Character Development
- One-click character unlock: Obtain the full range of cats (from EX to Legend Rare), with level caps maxed out (including bonuses).
- Evolution forms and instincts: One-click unlock of the third and fourth evolution forms for all characters, and max out their instincts.
- Specific cat unlock: Enter a specific cat number to precisely unlock the individual characters you want.
- Bonus Explorer Team (加碼多多探險隊): One-click raise of the Explorer Team to level 130 with full experience, and upgrade all members to 10 Legend-rank members.

### 3. Main Story Chapters and Stage Progress
- One-click clear all stages: Supports the World Story (Chapters 1–3), Future Story (Chapters 1–3), Cosmos Story (Chapters 1–3), Demon World Story, and the Tutorial.
- Highest-quality Gold Treasures: One-click fill of the highest-tier Gold Treasures for all chapters of the World, Future, and Cosmos Stories.
- All medal achievements: One-click unlock of all in-game achievement medals.

### 4. Account Copying and Save Management
- Account copying: Copy all progress from the current account to a brand-new blank account. This keeps your progress while creating a completely independent account.
- History backup and restore: The backend automatically keeps a historical version of each edit. You can search by inquiry code (詢問碼) to restore to a new account at any time.
- Account safety health check: Built-in save diagnostics automatically check whether supplies are excessive and whether time settings are abnormal, giving early warnings of ban risk.

yoza10635/dsh-argp.body:
[English](https://github.com/yoza10635/dsh-argp/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Chinese

# dsh-argp — Entity-label context compaction: deterministic pruning of tool results by label (0 LLM) + LLM summarization of conversation prose during compaction

**Long sessions fill the context window, and per-turn LLM summaries are expensive and break the prefix cache.** This plugin is a context compaction plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). It only **deterministically prunes (0 LLM)** tool results that are stale, superseded, or from non-focus turns, tagged by entity label. The pruned original text stays in the log and can be retrieved verbatim by label. Conversation prose is summarized by an LLM only inside the compaction transaction. When context crosses the threshold, it is condensed automatically, and when a request is rejected for exceeding the window, pruning is retried automatically.

46-turn measurement: wall clock 43.3 min · DeepSeek off-peak reference price 3.69 CNY · prefix cache hit rate 97.8% (n=1, see the note below the table).

## Installation

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-argp
```

**Works immediately after installation, no manual configuration needed**: the plugin package ships a bundle patch (it disables the host's built-in `compaction-basic` and mounts this plugin), and the profile layer only handles config overrides.

**Host requirement**: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (pre-releases are included in the match; the current latest `0.2.2-rc.3` has been tested). The host must be on the **0.2.x line** (npm `next` channel or the corresponding desktop version). The npm `latest` channel (0.1.x) is outside the accepted range, and the plugin will be **silently skipped** by the host. If you don't see `[argp]` logs or the `/argp` command after installing, clone this repo and run the preflight check: `node scripts/doctor.mjs --dsh <dsh install root>`.

> **If you install within 24 hours of release, specify the version explicitly.** pnpm 11's `minimumReleaseAge` defaults to 24 hours, so a just-published version is silently skipped and falls back to an older one. Use `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-argp@<version>`, or set `minimumReleaseAgeExclude: [dsh-argp]` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

> **Not enabled by default under the minimal preset** (`skipPresets: ['minimal']`). When needed, add `config: { skipPresets: [] }` via a modify at the profile layer.
